sensitivity_analysis.paper_statement: Sensitivity analysis: Spearman ρ range [0.968, 1.000], mean=0.990 across ±10% weight perturbations. Rankings are stable (ρ_min ≥ 0.90).

positive_results.mechanism: PDE5 inhibitor — reduces pulmonary vascular resistance via cGMP/PKG
positive_results.notes: FDA-approved for PAH (Revatio). Landmark RCT.

positive_results.mechanism: BCR-ABL/PDGFR kinase inhibitor — blocks vascular smooth muscle proliferation
positive_results.notes: Phase 2 data (IMPRES trial). PDGFRB expressed in PAH vessels.

positive_results.mechanism: Dual endothelin receptor antagonist (ET-A/ET-B) — reduces pulmonary vasoconstriction
positive_results.notes: First oral approved ERA for PAH.

positive_results.mechanism: Anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody — depletes B cells, reducing autoimmune inflammation
positive_results.notes: Approved for anti-TNF refractory RA.

shared_pathways: Viral protein interaction with cytokine and cytokine receptor

positive_results.mechanism: DHFR inhibitor / anti-inflammatory DMARD — first-line RA treatment
positive_results.notes: Anchor DMARD for RA for decades.

positive_results.mechanism: TLR7/9 inhibitor via lysosomal pH disruption — dampens innate immune activation
positive_results.notes: Standard DMARD in RA triple therapy.

positive_results.mechanism: AMPK activator — reduces insulin resistance and androgen excess in PCOS
positive_results.notes: Systematic review and meta-analysis of metformin in PCOS.

positive_results.mechanism: CRBN E3 ligase substrate — degrades Ikaros/Aiolos, anti-myeloma and anti-angiogenic
positive_results.notes: Landmark Singhal et al. N Engl J Med 1999 paper.

positive_results.mechanism: Glucocorticoid receptor agonist — induces apoptosis in myeloma cells
positive_results.notes: Backbone of almost all myeloma regimens.

positive_results.mechanism: Proteasome (26S) inhibitor — induces UPS-mediated apoptosis in myeloma
positive_results.notes: FDA approved for myeloma 2003.

positive_results.mechanism: BCR-ABL tyrosine kinase inhibitor — directly targets the driver oncoprotein
positive_results.notes: Prototype precision oncology. ABL1 is dominant CML gene.

positive_results.mechanism: Non-selective beta-adrenergic blocker — reduces peripheral tremor amplitude
positive_results.notes: First-line treatment for essential tremor.

positive_results.mechanism: K-ATP channel opener (KCNJ8/ABCC9) — prolongs anagen phase in hair follicles
positive_results.notes: Classic repurposing from hypertension to hair loss.

positive_results.mechanism: 5-alpha reductase (SRD5A1/SRD5A2) inhibitor — reduces scalp DHT
positive_results.notes: Approved for androgenetic alopecia.

positive_results.mechanism: Irreversible COX-1 inhibitor — reduces platelet aggregation and thrombosis
positive_results.notes: Standard antiplatelet in secondary prevention.

positive_results.mechanism: HMGCR inhibitor — reduces LDL-C and plaque formation
positive_results.notes: TNT trial. Statin for CAD is definitive guideline.

positive_results.mechanism: SERM — competitively blocks estrogen receptor (ESR1) in breast tissue
positive_results.notes: Definitive for ER+ breast cancer.

positive_results.mechanism: SERM — blocks ESR1 in breast tissue, reduces invasive breast cancer risk
positive_results.notes: STAR trial vs tamoxifen.

positive_results.mechanism: NMDA receptor antagonist + dopamine release promoter — reduces motor symptoms
positive_results.notes: First antiviral drug repurposed for PD (1969).

positive_results.mechanism: Irreversible MAO-B inhibitor — prevents dopamine breakdown
positive_results.notes: TEMPO trial. Approved for early PD.

shared_pathways: Signaling pathways regulating pluripotency of stem cells

positive_results.mechanism: AMPK activator — inhibits hepatic gluconeogenesis and improves insulin sensitivity
positive_results.notes: First-line pharmacotherapy for T2DM worldwide.

positive_results.mechanism: PPARγ agonist — improves insulin sensitivity in adipose and muscle
positive_results.notes: Approved TZD for T2DM.

positive_results.mechanism: mTOR (MTOR) inhibitor — targets hyperactivated TSC1/TSC2-mTOR pathway
positive_results.notes: EXIST-1/EXIST-2 trials. Directly targets TSC pathway.

positive_results.mechanism: Sodium channel blocker + GABA potentiator + HDAC inhibitor — broad anticonvulsant
positive_results.notes: Broad-spectrum AED for multiple seizure types.

positive_results.mechanism: Voltage-gated calcium channel α2δ subunit (CACNA2D1/2) blocker — reduces neuronal excitability
positive_results.notes: Approved adjunctive AED.

positive_results.mechanism: Anti-C5 monoclonal antibody — blocks terminal complement activation
positive_results.notes: Landmark TRIUMPH trial. C5 is the principal PNH gene.

positive_results.mechanism: CFTR potentiator — increases channel open probability in G551D mutation
positive_results.notes: Precision CFTR therapy. STRIVE trial.

positive_results.mechanism: TLR7/9 inhibitor — reduces type I interferon signalling in SLE
positive_results.notes: Cornerstone drug for SLE — reduces flares and improves survival.

positive_results.mechanism: Microtubule polymerisation inhibitor — blocks NLRP3 inflammasome activation
positive_results.notes: Acute and chronic gout prophylaxis. Also for pericarditis.

positive_results.mechanism: Xanthine oxidase inhibitor — reduces uric acid synthesis
positive_results.notes: First-line ULT for gout.

positive_results.mechanism: Microtubule inhibitor / NLRP3 inflammasome blocker — reduces pericardial inflammation
positive_results.notes: COPE trial. Halves recurrence rate in pericarditis.

positive_results.mechanism: Aldosterone receptor antagonist — reduces cardiac fibrosis and fluid retention
positive_results.notes: RALES trial. Reduces mortality in HFrEF.

positive_results.mechanism: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitor — increases synaptic acetylcholine in AD
positive_results.notes: Standard symptomatic treatment for mild-moderate AD.

positive_results.mechanism: NMDA receptor antagonist (GRIN1/GRIN2B) — reduces excitotoxicity in AD
positive_results.notes: Approved for moderate-severe AD.

positive_results.mechanism: HMGCR inhibitor — blocks cholesterol synthesis and up-regulates LDLR
positive_results.notes: ASCOT-LLA trial. Definitive LDL-lowering.

positive_results.mechanism: 5-alpha reductase inhibitor — reduces prostate DHT and gland volume
positive_results.notes: First approved 5-ARI for BPH.

positive_results.mechanism: Beta-blocker — promotes vasoconstriction and apoptosis in hemangioma endothelium
positive_results.notes: Serendipitous discovery 2008. Now first-line for infantile hemangioma.

positive_results.mechanism: KIT/PDGFRA tyrosine kinase inhibitor — targets driver mutations in GIST
positive_results.notes: Transformed prognosis of GIST. KIT expressed in >85% GIST.

positive_results.mechanism: Anti-α4 integrin (ITGA4) antibody — blocks lymphocyte trafficking to CNS
positive_results.notes: AFFIRM trial. Highly effective for relapsing MS.

positive_results.mechanism: Glutamate release inhibitor — reduces excitotoxicity in motor neurons
positive_results.notes: Only small-molecule ALS drug with survival benefit.

negative_results.mechanism: Dopamine D2 receptor ANTAGONIST — worsens motor symptoms in PD
negative_results.notes: Absolute contraindication in PD. Drug-induced parkinsonism.

negative_results.mechanism: Non-selective beta-blocker — causes life-threatening bronchospasm in asthma
Biguanide — AMPK activation has no established anti-myeloma mechanism
negative_results.notes: Some in-vitro data but no clinical benefit in myeloma.

negative_results.mechanism: COX inhibitor — no established connection to dopaminergic neurodegeneration
negative_results.notes: Aspirin targets COX pathway, unrelated to dopamine/synuclein.

negative_results.mechanism: HMGCR inhibitor — no established mechanism in CFTR dysfunction
negative_results.notes: Statin targets cholesterol, not chloride channel biology.

negative_results.mechanism: ACE inhibitor — no established anticonvulsant mechanism
negative_results.notes: RAAS pathway is unrelated to seizure biology.

negative_results.mechanism: Proton pump inhibitor — H+/K+ ATPase inhibition unrelated to MS autoimmunity
negative_results.notes: Gastric acid suppression has no mechanism in MS.

negative_results.mechanism: Loop diuretic — renal electrolyte mechanism, no AD-relevant target
negative_results.notes: Diuretic mechanism unrelated to amyloid/tau/cholinergic pathways.

negative_results.mechanism: Dopamine D2 antagonist antiemetic — directly worsens PD motor symptoms
negative_results.notes: Dopamine antagonists are absolutely contraindicated in PD.

negative_results.mechanism: Vitamin K antagonist (anticoagulant) — no anticonvulsant mechanism
negative_results.notes: Coagulation cascade is unrelated to seizure threshold.

negative_results.mechanism: Cardiac glycoside / Na+/K+ ATPase inhibitor — no autoimmune mechanism
negative_results.notes: Cardiac drug with no immunomodulatory target in RA.

negative_results.mechanism: Xanthine oxidase inhibitor — reduces uric acid, no anti-myeloma target
negative_results.notes: Used to prevent tumour lysis syndrome but not anti-myeloma.

negative_results.mechanism: Beta-1 selective blocker — can mask hypoglycaemia, no T2DM benefit
negative_results.notes: Beta-blockers are not used for T2DM treatment.

negative_results.mechanism: 5-HT3 receptor antagonist (antiemetic) — unrelated to pulmonary vasomotor tone
negative_results.notes: Serotonin receptor subtype has no role in PAH pathogenesis.

negative_results.mechanism: Proton pump inhibitor — unrelated to dopaminergic or alpha-synuclein biology
negative_results.notes: Gastric PPI with no PD mechanism.
